title: DAN LOEB'S THIRD POINT JUST UPDATED ITS STOCK PORTFOLIO
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
Loeb walked into mega-cap tech and out of last quarter's names. New  
positions include $475M of Meta (META), $343M of Nvidia (NVDA) and  
$231M of Microsoft (MSFT), plus a $439M bet on insurer Unum (UNM).  
SpaceX (SPCX) was raised 443.42% to $148M. He sold out of Warner Bros.  
Discovery (WBD) ($533M), Amazon (AMZN) ($417M), Norfolk Southern  
(NSC), Danaher (DHR) and Union Pacific (UNP), and slashed Alphabet  
(GOOGL) by 82.93%.  
  
Here are the top holdings as of the end of Q3:  
  
\- $475M of Meta (META) (new)  
\- $439M of Unum (UNM) (new)  
\- $343M of Nvidia (NVDA) (new)  
\- $235M of CRH (CRH) (added 29.38%)  
\- $234M of Block (XYZ) (added 24.27%)  
\- $231M of Microsoft (MSFT) (new)  
\- $220M of Flex (FLEX) (added 94.17%)  
\- $214M of Capital One (COF) (added 34.55%)  
\- $208M of Keysight (KEYS)  
\- $202M of Live Nation (LYV) (added 5.29%)  
\- $191M of APi Group (APG) (added 72.25%)  
\- $183M of TSMC (TSM) (cut 13.04%)  
\- $148M of SpaceX (SPCX) (added 443.42%)  
\- $146M of Telephone and Data Systems (TDS) (cut 31.47%)  
\- $135M of Liberty Formula One (FWONK) (new)  
\- $135M of Ares (ARES) (added 209.33%)  
\- $113M of Casey's (CASY) (new)  
\- $112M of Somnigroup (SGI) (cut 29.98%)  
\- $109M of Bank of America (BAC) (new)  
\- $108M of MasTec (MTZ) (added 74.14%)  
\- $105M of Hut 8 (HUT)  
\- $60M of Alphabet (GOOGL) (cut 82.93%)  
\- $54M of Alphabet (GOOGL) (depositary shares)  
\- $43M of Performance Food (PFGC) (cut 29.89%)  
  
Sold out: Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD), Amazon (AMZN), Norfolk  
Southern (NSC), Carpenter Technology (CRS), TransDigm (TDG), Danaher  
(DHR), Union Pacific (UNP), TTM Technologies (TTMI), ASML (ASML),  
Sysco (SYY)  
  
Holdings are as of September 30, per Third Point's Q3 13F filing. 13Fs  
only cover long U.S.-listed positions and lag the market, so the fund  
may have changed these since then. Third Point reported 38 positions  
worth $4.54B in equity ($4.59B including other lines).  
  
The Unum stake is the surprise next to the new Meta, Nvidia and  
Microsoft lines. How are you reading that rotation — especially the  
exit from Amazon and Warner Bros. Discovery?
